mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies at Verona City Hall with a temperature of 51 degrees under a Waning Gibbous moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. We are looking at an overnight low of 48 degrees with rain in the forecast.

Regarding city services, remember that refuse and recycling are handled by Pellitteri Waste Systems, and you can find your collection schedule on their app. Also, please note that winter parking rules begin on November 20.
There is plenty to do, including the Main Street Trick-Or-Treat today, live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company today, and the Dane County Farmer's Market tomorrow.
In a report from October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old Verona man for an O W I after he was discovered stopped in an intersection for twenty minutes.

Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store is currently open and will be serving until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
